tagline: The Andaman's iconic island — Phuket's signature day-trip.
summary: Koh Phi Phi is the Andaman's iconic island destination, the signature day-trip from both Phuket (~25 nm) and Krabi (~22 nm). It carries some of the densest island-tourism flow in Southeast Asia on crowded, often-rough speedboats — exactly the comfort and weather gap a premium foiling tier closes.

demand_signals.detail: Among the highest-volume island day-trip destinations in SEA, from Phuket and Krabi.
Speedboat rides are frequently a pounding ride and monsoon-cancelled.
High-end resort segment alongside mass day-trip flow.

journeys.note: Signature Andaman day-trip — already a sealed corridor.

navier_fit: Very high as the Andaman's signature day-trip; clean Pioneer II legs with massive existing volume; corridors already bound to gold route_ids.
competitive_landscape: Dense, crowded speedboats and ferries — rough rides, monsoon closures, no premium tier.
seasonality: SW monsoon (May-Oct) rough with closures; high season Nov-Apr. Foiling extends the comfortable window.
regulatory_note: Thai Marine Department and Marine National Park rules (including periodic Maya Bay closures) at established jetties.
